VNA 输出功率极低，测量时附近强信号可能干扰，选择合适带宽。: VNA output power is very low, so nearby strong signals may interfere while measuring; choose a suitable span.
串接馈线测量正反向功率，实时监视匹配状态。: Connected in series with the feedline to measure forward and reflected power, monitoring the match in real time.
低成本便携 VNA，测 S11、驻波比、阻抗、史密斯圆图，DIY 时代标配。: Low-cost portable VNA measuring S11, SWR, impedance and the Smith chart — standard kit in the DIY era.
判阻抗性质: Judge the nature of the impedance
同一圆上的点驻波比相同，离圆心越远驻波比越大、匹配越差。: Points on the same circle have the same SWR; the further from the centre, the higher the SWR and the worse the match.
圆图上半部分为感性（+jX），下半部分为容性（-jX）。: The upper half of the chart is inductive (+jX) and the lower half capacitive (−jX).
对应系统特性阻抗（通常 50Ω），圆心处驻波比 = 1:1，完全匹配。: Corresponds to the system's characteristic impedance (usually 50 Ω); at the centre SWR = 1:1, a perfect match.
手持专用仪表，扫描天线驻波比与谐振频率，操作简单。: A dedicated handheld instrument that sweeps the antenna's SWR and resonant frequency; simple to operate.
扫描频率，驻波比最低处即为天线谐振频率。: Sweep the frequency; the antenna's resonant frequency is where the SWR is lowest.
把复数阻抗（电阻 + 电抗）映射到一个圆内，直观显示阻抗与匹配状态。: Maps a complex impedance (resistance + reactance) inside a circle, showing impedance and matching state at a glance.
测量前先校准（开路 / 短路 / 50Ω 负载），尤其 NanoVNA 需做 S: Calibrate before measuring (open / short / 50 Ω load); the NanoVNA in particular needs SOL calibration.
测量天线时应远离金属物与人体，避免影响谐振频率读数。: When measuring an antenna stay clear of metal objects and of your own body, so the resonant frequency reading is not affected.
谐振点偏感性/容性，决定需加电容还是电感补偿。: Whether the resonant point is inductive or capacitive determines whether a capacitor or an inductor is needed for compensation.
谐振频率偏高可加长振子，偏低则剪短，边调边扫频。: If the resonant frequency is too high, lengthen the element; if too low, shorten it — adjusting and re-sweeping as you go.
配合已知负载检查馈线损耗与电气长度。: With a known load, check the feedline's loss and electrical length.
驻波比 ≤ 2:1 的频率范围，即天线可用带宽。: The frequency range over which SWR ≤ 2:1, i.e. the antenna's usable bandwidth.
